verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a consumer GPU, since its companion software (the AMD Software app with its home tab and HYPR-RX profiles) could plausibly ship an in-app AI assistant. The evidence pack documents no built-in assistant that accepts delegated tasks. ROCm support for running vLLM, llama.cpp or PyTorch locally is a developer building block for making your own assistant, not a built-in one, so it earns no credit here.
